item.title: There should be plenty angling to go fishing on New Year’s Day
item.description: Talking of the New Year, I’m sure regular readers of this column will be aware that it is all about fishing, and specifically the start of the salmon fishing season on the River Drowes on January 1. So what happened this time last year, just as anglers were filling their flasks and stuffing the last of the turkey into a sandwich, ready for the off? item.title: Farmers welcome government climbdown on inheritance tax changes
item.description: Farmers have welcomed a move by the Labour government to increase inheritance tax (IHT) thresholds from £1 million to £2.5 million.

item.title: Woman found with marks on neck and footprint on her chest
item.description: A 33-year-old man has appeared before a special court sitting accused of domestic abuse charges after his partner was found with neck marks and a footprint on her chest.

item.title: Appeal for witnesses after BMW damaged in road traffic incident
item.description: The PSNI are appealing for witnesses after a BMW was damaged in a road traffic collision in Fivemiletown.

item.title: 'Serial domestic abuser' accused of stalking ex-partner
item.description: A 33-year-old man accused of a campaign of domestic abuse against his ex-partner, including harassment and stalking, has been refused bail.

item.title: Tributes paid to 'selfless' Padraig McDonald after death after Boxing Day crash
item.description: Tributes have been paid to a Tyrone man who died after a road traffic collision in Cookstown on Boxing Day.

item.title: Clogher man accused of serious assault returned for trial
item.description: A forty-year-old Clogher man accused of what was described in court as “an extremely serious assault in a prolonged attack" has been returned for trial.

item.title: Mother and son extradited from Malta returned for trial
item.description: A mother and son extradited from Malta on multiple charges of child abuse have been returned for trial.

item.title: Police warning as shops targeted by 'organised gang' in shoplifting spree
item.description: Police are appealing for help tracing an ‘organised gang’ they believe to be behind a rise in thefts from local shops in Fermanagh and Omagh.

item.title: King's New Year's Honours list revealed with Fermanagh and Tyrone recipients
item.description: Superintendent Robert McGowan is among those from Fermanagh and Tyrone to be named on the New Year’s Honours list.
